entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: A human rookie Wojek officer killed by a Rakdos goblin's bomb, who returned as a ghost to investigate his death.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Veteran Wojek officer, Borca's commander and partner.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Vampire whose attempt to conquer Ravnica Kos stopped.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild that refused to let Kos retire.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild whose life insurance agreement let Borca return as a ghost.

entities.name: Nelly
entities.description: Borca's niece whom he inspired to join the Legion.

events.summary: Borca is killed in a bomb attack by a Rakdos goblin.
events.quote: Borca was killed during a terrorist attack by a Rakdos goblin

events.summary: Borca returns as a ghost under an Orzhov life insurance agreement to pursue justice, frustrating Kos.
events.quote: Borca did enter into an Orzhov life insurance agreement

events.summary: Kos apprehends Szadek during the Decamillennial and Borca is listed as an investigator.
events.quote: when Kos apprehended Szadek during the Decamillennial
